{{Short description|Canadian academic}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=January 2025}}

'''Alaa Abd-El-Aziz''' is a Canadian academic and former president of the [[University of Prince Edward Island]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-12-08 |title=President of University of Prince Edward Island resigns amid misconduct allegations |url=https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2021/12/08/president-of-university-of-prince-edward-island-resigns-citing-health-concerns.html |access-date=2022-09-05 |website=thestar.com |language=en}}</ref>

== Early life ==
Abd-El-Aziz completed his bachelor's and master's at the [[Ain Shams University]] in 1985 and 1989 respectively.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae |url=http://files.upei.ca/president/Short_CV_Abd-El-Aziz.pdf |access-date=5 September 2022 |website=[[University of Prince Edward Island]]}}</ref> He completed a PhD at the [[University of Saskatchewan]] in 1989.<ref name=":0" />

[[File:Photo of Alaa S Abd El Aziz taken 15 March 2010 in Kelowna.peg.jpg|thumb|Abd El Aziz in 2010]]

== Career ==
Abd-El-Aziz joined the [[University of Toronto]] as a lecturer in 1989.<ref name=":0" /> In 1990, he joined the [[University of Winnipeg]] as an [[assistant professor]] and became a full professor in 1997 and worked there till 2006.<ref name=":0" />

From 1991 to 2008, Abd-El-Aziz was an adjunct professor at the [[University of Manitoba]].<ref name=":0" /> He was also an adjunct at the [[Université de Sherbrooke]] and the [[University of Winnipeg]].<ref name=":0" />

Abd-El-Aziz was the former Provost of the [[University of British Columbia Okanagan]].{{citation needed|date=March 2023}} From 2006 to 2011, he was the professor of chemistry at the University of British Columbia Okanagan.<ref name=":0" />

=== University of Prince Edward Island ===
Alaa Abd-El-Aziz assumed the presidency of [[University of Prince Edward Island]] (UPEI) in July 2011 after being selected in November 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=24 November 2010 |title= UPEI names President-designate  |url=https://www.upei.ca/communications/news/2010/11/upei-names-president-designate/ |access-date=21 June 2023 |website=Saltwire}}</ref>

{{cn span|text=Abd-El-Aziz oversaw a growing enrolment at UPEI, with the number of international students growing from 536 in 2012 to 1,400 from 90 countries in 2021, as well as the expansion of its [[nursing]] school and the creation of a faculty of medicine in partnership with [[Memorial University of Newfoundland]]. |date=September 2023}}

In 2013, university employees filed [[sexual harassment]] complaints against Abd-El-Aziz before the [[Human rights commission#Canada|P.E.I. Human Rights Commission]]. According to Tom Cullen, then-chairman of UPEI's board of governors, it involved allegations of "inappropriate comments between colleagues".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ross |first=Ryan |date=24 January 2013 |title=Sexual harassment complaint filed against UPEI president |url=https://www.saltwire.com/prince-edward-island/news/sexual-harassment-complaint-filed-against-upei-president-95510/ |access-date=21 June 2023 |website=Saltwire}}</ref> Later the same year, UPEI reached a settlement with the two complainants,<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=15 June 2023 |title= UPEI settles sexual harassment complaints |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/prince-edward-island/upei-settles-sexual-harassment-complaints-1.1323425 |access-date=21 June 2023 |website=CBC News}}</ref> with non-disclosure agreements signed by all parties involved.<ref name="On leave">{{Cite web |last=Ryan |first=Carolyn |date=15 June 2023 |title= UPEI vice-president placed on leave as faculty call for board resignations |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/prince-edward-island/pei-upei-report-reaction-leave-faculty-letter-1.6877595/|access-date=21 June 2023 |website=CBC News}}</ref>

Abd-El-Aziz's contract was renewed in 2015,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Chang |first=Arturo |date=8 December 2021 |title=UPEI board of governors launches third-party review of new allegations involving ex-president |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/prince-edward-island/pei-upei-third-party-investigation-president-misconduct-1.6278142 |access-date=5 September 2022 |website=CBC news}}</ref> 2018 and 2021.<ref name="Chair resigns">{{Cite web |last=Ryan |first=Carolyn |date=21 June 2013 |title=Chair of UPEI's board of governors resigns after critical report, saying new leadership needed |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/prince-edward-island/pei-upei-pat-sinnott-resigns-1.6884278/ |access-date=21 June 2023 |website=CBC News}}</ref> [[Atlantic Business Magazine]] declared him innovator of the year in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Alaa Abd-El-Aziz is our 2020 Innovator of the Year |url=https://atlanticbusinessmagazine.ca/article/dr-alaa-abd-el-aziz-is-our-2020-innovator-of-the-year/ |access-date=2022-09-05 |website=Atlantic Business Magazine |language=en-US}}</ref>

Abd-El-Aziz agreed to stay at the university until 2025 but resigned in December 2021 citing health reasons following a report by [[CBC News]] alleging that numerous non-disclosure agreements at UPEI had created "a culture of silence and fear" on campus and a [[toxic workplace]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Campbell |first=Kerry |date=3 December 2021 |title=Use of NDAs has created 'culture of silence and fear' on UPEI campus, former prof says |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/prince-edward-island/pei-upei-non-disclosure-agreements-harassment-allegations-1.6271071 |access-date=5 September 2022 |website=CBC News}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Contributed |title=LETTER: What happened to third party review of UPEI president? {{!}} SaltWire |url=https://www.saltwire.com/atlantic-canada/opinion/letter-what-happened-to-third-party-review-of-upei-president-100730837/ |access-date=2022-09-05 |website=www.saltwire.com |language=en}}</ref> Following Alaa Abd-El-Aziz's resignation, [[Gregory Keefe|Greg Keefe]] was named Interim President and Vice-Chancellor on December 13, 2021.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2021-12-13 |title=University of Prince Edward Island appoints interim president, hires investigator |language=en-CA |work=The Globe and Mail |url=https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/article-university-of-prince-edward-island-appoints-interim-president-hires/ |access-date=2022-09-05}}</ref>

Appointed by UPEI a few days after the resignation,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prominent Toronto lawyer to look into alleged UPEI workplace misconduct |url=https://ca.news.yahoo.com/prominent-toronto-lawyer-look-alleged-134407257.html |access-date=2022-09-05 |website=ca.news.yahoo.com |language=en-CA}}</ref> law firm Rubin Thomlinson found 29 non-disclosure agreements were signed at UPEI in the decade Abd-El-Aziz was in charge.<ref name="On leave"/><ref name="Chair resigns"/>
